convert_doge_model: convert Doge model weights from source directory to Hugging Face format and save to output directory
load_weights: load safetensor weight files from a directory and merge them into a single state dictionary
convert_state_dict: convert a Doge model state dictionary to Hugging Face key naming convention
map_old_key_to_new: map a source model key to the Hugging Face equivalent using regex pattern matching
run_convert_cli: run the CLI converter with input and output directories to transform Doge weights to HF format
